# OpenCV.js browser build

`opencv-4.13.0.js` is the official OpenCV.js 4.13.0 browser build from
https://docs.opencv.org/4.13.0/opencv.js. It is loaded only on KYC document
capture screens. SHA-256:
`63366510248adf3a7eddf3e793dd825404efb7df3749f4d6f8557c7fa4ca8aa0`.

OpenCV is licensed under Apache License 2.0. The upstream license is copied in
`LICENSE.opencv`.
